Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rohan - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Sunita - 36 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Karan - 36 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Riya - 12 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
5. Sharda - 70 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Rohan, what's the plan today?"

[Rohan hides behind the tree.]

Sunita: "And then?"

[Rohan searches for his lost ball.]

Sunita (gently): "Rohan, are you okay?"

[Rohan bursts out laughing.]

Rohan: "How beautiful!"

[Snow begins to fall.]

Rohan (excited): "Hey, look at that!"

[The sun rises over the village.]

Rohan (laughing): "That was such a fun day!"
